workbook_profile.name: INFRASTRUCTURE_WORKBOOK_PROFILE_V1
workbook_profile.installation_scope_rule: SourceInstallationScopeId is exactly the opaque non-secret LLD-01 DataInstanceIdentityReader data_instance_id. Restoring that canonical data instance preserves same-installation scope; a genuinely new empty data instance receives a different scope. LLD-08 stores no competing installation identity.

sheets.name: Metadata
rules: unknown required-format key does not change semantics; unsupported version blocks import

sheets.name: Network Elements
sheets.identity: Soma* ids are authoritative targets only when SourceInstallationScopeId equals the current Foundation data_instance_id; on foreign scope they are provenance/candidate evidence only
sheets.blank_rule: blank optional existing-target cells preserve prior accepted value/relationship; explicit clearing requires a separately represented reviewed operation and is not encoded by blank

sheets.name: IP Addresses
rules: same-installation SomaIpId may target existing IP relation
Primary accepts explicit TRUE/FALSE only; blank preserves existing primary state for existing relation and means non-primary proposal for new relation
missing IP rows never remove existing IPs

generation: registration_template writes Metadata plus header-only Network Elements/IP Addresses sheets with blank same-installation ids
discovery writes human-readable current rows and same-installation ids for deterministic provenance but is observational
round_trip writes same current data and stable same-installation IDs intended for reviewed updates
no formulas/macros/external links/hidden authoritative sheets/credentials/topology fields
workbook generation never mutates domain state
preflight: file must pass LLD-08 resource bounds and shared hardened ZIP/path/active-content checks before openpyxl

reject VBA/macro content, formulas in authoritative cells, external links, embedded executable/OLE objects, malformed duplicate metadata keys, unsupported required sheets/headers and forbidden secret/topology headers
source file opened read-only and never rewritten
row_normalization: strings pass bound + Unicode normalization appropriate to field
numeric Rack values require exact integers, never spreadsheet float rounding
same-installation local IDs require canonical UUIDv4 syntax when nonblank
foreign local IDs retained only in normalized staging provenance
each normalized row receives SHA-256 row_fingerprint over versioned canonical JSON
logical_fingerprint: canonical Metadata semantic fields excluding GeneratedAtUtc are encoded with profile/version
normalized Network Elements rows are sorted by same-installation local id when authoritative, else stable row fingerprint with duplicate occurrence ordinal
normalized IP rows likewise sorted; duplicate rows remain multiplicity-significant
SHA-256 over canonical UTF-8 JSON stream yields logical_fingerprint
workbook row order changes alone do not create a different logical content identity
staging_and_review: parsing writes only unpublished technical run/staging rows
same-installation exact local ID may propose update to exactly that entity after current-state checks
foreign/local-missing identity uses candidate search and can only propose reviewed create/link; descriptive fields never prove target
related Site/Room/Rack/Model/Cloud references use same-installation IDs when valid, otherwise explicit candidate/creation review
Network Element row proposal and its IP rows are grouped by target key for impact display
review partitions creations, updates, unchanged, ambiguity, duplicate candidates, unknown references, invalid relationships, skips and warnings
missing rows and blank optional cells are nondestructive
acceptance: accepted run revalidates every target/current relation using the same manual Infrastructure services inside one UnitOfWork
cross-Site Rack/Cloud, U occupancy, multiple-primary, containment cycle, archived target, foreign identity overwrite and secret/topology fields fail before mutation
reviewed batch is atomic; one invalid/stale intended accepted target aborts whole acceptance
after success record bounded row decisions/replay index and allow technical staging minimization

rules: allocate export_id and commit it to the durable checkpoint before creating any temp artifact; the export_id is then immutable for this job and supplies the artifact filename suffix identity
temp_filename/final_filename are bounded filename-only sibling identities resolved only beneath the validated destination_directory; no checkpoint field grants arbitrary filesystem path authority
verified_sha256 and verified_size_bytes are populated only after the closed temp workbook is reopened and passes SOMA_INFRASTRUCTURE_WORKBOOK_V1 profile/row-count/active-content verification

crash_recovery_policy.pre_publication: For queued/writing/verifying/verified interruption, trust only committed checkpoint identity. Delete an unpublished temp file only after proving it is the exact bounded sibling temp_filename owned by this job/export_id under the still-valid destination. A verified temp may be reused only after reopen plus exact hash/size/profile verification; otherwise discard that owned temp and regenerate from a fresh stable Infrastructure read snapshot. Never resume openpyxl or an in-memory row cursor.
crash_recovery_policy.published_before_evidence: If phase=published but infrastructure_workbook_exports evidence is absent, never rewrite or republish the artifact. Reopen only the exact checkpoint final_filename beneath the validated destination and require its SHA-256 and byte size to equal verified_sha256/verified_size_bytes. If exact, idempotently record the single infrastructure_workbook_exports row keyed by export_id and advance to evidence_recorded; if missing or mismatched, fail closed with bounded diagnostic state and never fabricate export evidence or delete/overwrite the final file.
crash_recovery_policy.evidence_recorded: If export evidence already exists for export_id, require its mode/scope/installation identity/final filename/hash/size to match the checkpoint/job payload exactly and finish idempotently without filesystem rewrite or second evidence insertion.
rules: published final files are operator-managed external artifacts and are never recovery cleanup targets

restart may observe newer live Infrastructure only when no artifact has been published; each regeneration uses one fresh stable read snapshot and the eventual export evidence describes only the successfully published bytes
unknown/malformed checkpoint phase or impossible phase-field combination fails closed rather than guessing progress

cancellation_policy.queued_or_prepublication: Cancellation is cooperative at safe boundaries before atomic publication. Close any active writer, then delete only an exact job-owned unpublished temp artifact after ownership validation; commit cancelled job state without export evidence.
cancellation_policy.publication_boundary: Once atomic publication begins, cancellation cannot interleave with rename/replace. The handler completes the bounded publication critical section before re-reading cancellation state.
cancellation_policy.postpublication: After exact final publication, cancellation no longer deletes or retracts the final workbook. The job must reconcile the already-published artifact to one infrastructure_workbook_exports evidence row, then terminate normally; a later operator file move/delete remains external artifact management rather than domain rollback.

jobs.sensitive_field_policy: no secrets/workbook cell bodies; destination_directory is local-path-sensitive technical job data only and is sanitized from audit/diagnostics; checkpoint stores filename-only temp/final identities rather than duplicate full paths
jobs.coalescing: none; each explicit export request is independent

rules: after deterministic nonrecursive discovery, commit candidate_manifest_sha256 over the ordered bounded candidate filename + stabilized size + stabilized mtime identity set before parsing the first candidate; candidate_index is meaningful only while that manifest fingerprint remains exact

before semantic parsing, stabilize the exact current_filename, hash it while checking size/mtime remain unchanged, then commit filename/size/mtime/SHA-256 to the checkpoint; a changed source identity is never spliced into existing staging

current_workbook_run_id and per-sheet last-committed row ordinals are durable restart cursors only for non-authoritative validating staging; recovery reopens from the beginning and verifies existing row fingerprints through the cursor rather than resuming an in-memory openpyxl iterator
published_run_ids is a bounded recovery cache, not replay authority; persisted workbook-run file/logical identities remain authoritative for idempotently skipping already-published review runs

crash_recovery_policy.revalidate_context: Before resuming any interrupted job, require the same Foundation data_instance_id and re-read the LLD-02 Infrastructure Import Directory setting. The current setting revision and normalized directory must still equal payload setting_revision/import_directory; otherwise terminate the stale job without scanning another path.
crash_recovery_policy.discovering: Never trust candidate_index without its manifest identity. Re-enumerate only the exact configured nonrecursive directory, stabilize candidate metadata and recompute candidate_manifest_sha256. If it differs from the checkpoint, reset discovery/current-candidate cursors and start a new deterministic scan generation; already-published runs are skipped through persisted replay identities rather than index position.
crash_recovery_policy.parsing_or_staging: Never resume an in-memory ZIP/openpyxl/parser position. Revalidate the exact current filename beneath the configured directory, require stabilized size/mtime and SHA-256 to equal the committed checkpoint, rerun hardened workbook preflight, reopen streaming from the beginning and verify every already-committed staging row fingerprint through the per-sheet row cursor before continuing. Any source/cursor/staging mismatch fails the unpublished validating run, cleans only that run's technical staging/proposals in a bounded UnitOfWork and restarts the candidate from a fresh validating run; it never merges two source generations.
crash_recovery_policy.publishing: Publishing one candidate is one bounded transaction that revalidates complete staging counts/fingerprint/proposal set and changes the run from validating to staged/reviewable with published_at_utc. A crash before commit leaves no reviewable partial run; a crash after commit is detected by exact persisted run identity and is skipped idempotently without duplicate proposals or a second review publication.
crash_recovery_policy.waiting_review_or_completed: Once all intended candidates have either bounded failure evidence or exact persisted staged/reviewable run publication, recovery never reparses those published runs. waiting_review/completed may only reconcile technical job/checkpoint state against the persisted run identities.
rules: source workbooks are always external read-only inputs and are never renamed, rewritten or deleted by recovery
no recovery path invokes Infrastructure domain mutation services; staged runs/proposals remain non-authoritative until explicit reviewed acceptance
unknown/malformed checkpoint phase, impossible cursor combination or persisted run identity mismatch fails closed instead of guessing progress

cancellation_policy.discovery_boundary: Cancellation during discovery stops before opening the next candidate and commits the durable job cancelled with no source-file mutation.
cancellation_policy.parsing_or_staging: Cancellation is cooperative between bounded staging checkpoints. Close readers, mark any current unpublished validating run failed with a bounded cancellation reason and remove only its technical staging/proposals when safe; never publish that incomplete candidate as reviewable.
cancellation_policy.publication_boundary: Cancellation cannot interleave with the short validating-to-staged publication transaction. After that transaction resolves, re-read cancellation state: if publication committed, preserve the complete staged/reviewable run and stop before the next candidate; if it rolled back, treat the candidate as unpublished and apply normal cancellation cleanup.
cancellation_policy.postpublication: Cancellation never retracts, rejects or deletes already-published staged/reviewed runs and never changes accepted Infrastructure state. Those runs remain available for explicit operator review/reject/accept independently of the cancelled discovery job.

jobs.sensitive_field_policy: no secrets/full workbook XML/unbounded cell bodies; import_directory is local-path-sensitive technical job data and is sanitized from audit/diagnostics; checkpoint stores bounded filename and digests/row ordinals rather than workbook rows
jobs.coalescing: at most one active Check-now job for the same setting_revision; a duplicate command reuses prior job through COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1

workbook_jobs.writer_lock_rule: No job holds SQLite writer transaction while enumerating directories, parsing XLSX, hashing, writing or verifying artifact files.
